DLC2303:4:t_015:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You've improved a little, Ensign $$リディ$$.」

DLC2303:4:t_015:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「As a soldier, I can't afford to lose to $$バナージ$$.」

DLC2303:4:t_015:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. Don't forget that pride.」

DLC2303:4:t_015:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
（Don't let your talent go to waste, $$リディ$$. You should be able to go much further.）

DLC2303:4:t_016:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You and $$バナージ$$ both seem to have cleared your heads a little, $$リディ$$.」

DLC2303:4:t_016:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Live the way you think is right. The results will follow.」

DLC2303:4:t_016:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That might sound irresponsible, but take it as advice from someone who's been around longer.」

DLC2303:4:t_016:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The same goes for you, $$リディ$$. But don't forget how you felt when you joined the military... Don't forget that pride.」

DLC2303:4:t_016:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
（Don't let your talent go to waste, $$リディ$$. You should be able to go much further.）

DLC2303:4:t_017:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「It looks like things between $$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$ have settled down for now too...」

DLC2303:4:t_017:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
（Now there's nothing left to worry about. All that's left is to move forward...）

DLC2303:4:t_018:1.en:
$$リディ$$
（The $$ユニコーン$$... The key to $$ラプラスの箱$$... If I could erase its existence, then $$ミネバ$$ and I...!）

DLC2303:4:t_019:1.en:
$$リディ$$
（The $$ユニコーン$$... The key to $$ラプラスの箱$$... If I could erase its existence, then $$ミネバ$$ and I...）

DLC2303:4:t_019:2.en:
$$リディ$$
（...I won't think about anything unnecessary now...! I have to stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$... If I don't survive, I can't change anything...!）

DLC2303:4:t_020:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch! If I push myself here, I won't be able to protect the Colonel at $$アクシズ$$!」

DLC2303:4:t_020:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$アンジェロ$$'s unit is falling back!」

DLC2303:4:t_021:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
（Someone who follows $$フル・フロンタル$$...）

DLC2303:4:t_021:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$ and $$フロンタル$$... Two $$赤い彗星$$s... Can we beat them...?）

DLC2303:4:t_100:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What...!? What's this intensity coming from Ensign $$リディ$$...!?」

DLC2303:4:t_100:2.en:
$$リディ$$
（$$バナージ$$! First, I'll make you realize how powerless you are!）

DLC2303:4:t_101:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think you can win just because your machine performs better!」

DLC2303:4:t_101:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'll show you that the $$ユニコーン$$'s power is the only reason you've been able to keep fighting until today!」

DLC2303:4:t_101:3.en:
$$リディ$$
（That's right...! That $$ガンダム$$ is the cause of everything...!）

DLC2303:4:t_101:4.en:
$$リディ$$
（If only that $$ガンダム$$ didn't exist...!）

DLC2303:4:t_102:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
（I'm sorry, $$リディ$$, $$バナージ$$... I have my hands full with my own problems...）

DLC2303:4:t_102:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
（Don't die. You too, $$カミーユ$$, $$カツ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$...）

DLC2303:4:t_102:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
（After $$シャア$$ and me, you'll be the ones to open the door to a new age.）

DLC2303:4:t_103:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（$$アクシズ$$ lies beyond these enemies...）

DLC2303:4:t_103:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（$$シャア・アズナブル$$...! At $$アクシズ$$, I'll find out what you're really after!）

DLC2303:4:t_104:0.en:
$$カツ$$
（Like hell I'm going to die here...!）

DLC2303:4:t_104:1.en:
$$カツ$$
（$$サラ$$...! I'll survive, no matter what! That's the promise I made you!）

DLC2303:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（If I die, I won't be able to get $$クェス$$ back...!）

DLC2303:4:t_105:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$クェス$$...! I'll come for you, I promise!）

DLC2303:4:t_106:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
（I'll live... I'll survive...! Life itself is the greatest possibility of all!）

DLC2303:4:t_106:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
（$$オードリー$$...! I'll survive with this $$ユニコーン$$!）

DLC2303:4:t_107:0.en:
$$リディ$$
（Forget about $$バナージ$$ for now, $$リディ$$...! Before you're a member of the $$マーセナス家$$, you're a soldier of the $$地球連邦軍$$!）

DLC2303:4:t_107:1.en:
$$リディ$$
（I'll live and protect the Earth...! Everything else comes after that!）

DLC2303:4:t_108:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ガンダム$$! The Federation's White Meteor! Your very existence stands in the Colonel's way!」

DLC2303:4:t_108:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$'s Guards captain...! This man is dangerous!」

DLC2303:4:t_108:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You recognize my skill! Then...!」

DLC2303:4:t_108:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No...! That's not the kind of danger I'm talking about!」

DLC2303:4:t_108:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$フロンタル$$ created a man like you. That makes him the truly dangerous one!」

DLC2303:4:t_109:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「This is a good opportunity, $$ユニコーン$$! I'll finish you here before this turns into a melee!」

DLC2303:4:t_109:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've decided to live with the $$ユニコーン$$! For $$オードリー$$, too!」

DLC2303:4:t_109:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll survive! And I'll see $$オードリー$$ again!」

review.context: Outcome epilogues give each younger pilot advice. Battle lines connect survival to their hopes for the future, while Riddhe struggles against his obsession and Amuro recognizes the danger behind Angelo's devotion to Frontal.
decisions: Riddhe's self-address retains his distinction between Marcenas family obligations and Earth Federation military duty.
Earth Federation Forces uses the Universal Century token, not the alternate-setting variants.
Both incomplete Mineva conditional lines retain the source's deliberately unspoken outcome.
White Meteor is Amuro's epithet; Red Comet refers to Char and Frontal.
